Filters.pickMonth: Pick a month, then another to make a range.
Filters.pickRangeEnd: Pick another month to end the range, or close to keep this one.
Filters.sessionTypesSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No session types} other {# session types}}
Filters.testSiteHint: Uganda's catch-all for testing and training, outside any district.

activeDevices.title: Active devices
activeDevices.description: Devices with at least one session collected in the period, each counted once however many months it was active. Counts only the session types chosen in the sessions filter.

images.title: Images
images.description: Every photo of a specimen, counted in the month the session was collected (program's timezone). A specimen photographed three times counts three times.

uniqueSpecimens.title: Unique specimens
uniqueSpecimens.description: Specimens collected in the period, each counted once however many images it has.

imagesPerActiveDevice.title: Images / device
imagesPerActiveDevice.description: Images ÷ active devices, for the same programs and period. Blank when no devices were active.

metadataCompleteness.title: Metadata complete
metadataCompleteness.description: Share of specimens whose record has all four: a species, a capture date, a location (its site's district, or else the session's GPS inside the country), and an operator name.

dhis2UploadRate.title: DHIS2 upload
dhis2UploadRate.description: Records sent to DHIS2 (their session is submitted) ÷ all records. Uganda only.

uniqueUsers.title: Unique users
uniqueUsers.description: VectorVerify users (reviewers, not field collectors) who logged in during the period, each counted once. Uses UTC months. Blank before login tracking began.

logins.title: Logins
logins.description: Every VectorVerify login during the period, all users. Uses UTC months. Blank before login tracking began.

Summary.heading: Summary, {period}
Summary.inProgressHint: {month} hasn't ended yet, so its numbers are still coming in.
Summary.timingNote: Times are seconds between consecutive images in a session, pauses and retakes included.

timingInfo.median: The middle gap: half the gaps between consecutive images are shorter. Every gap in every session in the period, pooled (Excel MEDIAN).
timingInfo.p25: A quarter of the gaps between consecutive images are shorter than this (Excel PERCENTILE.INC at 0.25).
timingInfo.p75: Three quarters of the gaps between consecutive images are shorter than this (Excel PERCENTILE.INC at 0.75).
timingInfo.mean: Sum of every gap between consecutive images ÷ number of gaps. Long pauses pull it up, so it sits above the median.
timingInfo.sd: How spread out the gaps are (Excel STDEV.S, sample standard deviation). Blank with fewer than two gaps.
